errors.text_span: wobei die linke y-Achse den Preis für Cer (Oxid), Neodym (Oxid), Lanthan (Oxid), PrNd Mischmetall, Terbium (Oxid) und Dysprosium (Oxid) darstellt
errors.evidence: The left y-axis is for all listed elements EXCEPT for Terbium (Oxid) and Dysprosium (Oxid), which use the dedicated right y-axis.
The right y-axis has a linear scale (0, 500, 1000, 1500...), not a logarithmic scale.

errors.text_span: auf über 350 US-Dollar/kg im Jahr 2012 ansteigt
errors.evidence: The price peak for Neodym (Oxid) occurred in mid-2011, not 2012.

errors.text_span: Die graue Linie für Terbium (Oxid) steigt von etwa 20 US-Dollar/kg im Jahr 2006 auf über 400 US-Dollar/kg im Jahr 2012
errors.evidence: This description is entirely wrong for Terbium. It uses the right y-axis, starting around 300 USD/kg, peaking above 4,000 USD/kg in 2011, not 400 USD/kg in 2012. The values were read from the wrong axis.
The line for Dysprosium (Oxid) is pink/magenta, not purple ('lila'). The purple ('violette') line represents Neodym (Oxid).

errors.text_span: Die dunkelblaue Linie für PrNd Mischmetall bleibt über die gesamte Periode niedrig und steigt nur leicht an.
errors.evidence: This is a severe over-generalization that completely ignores the massive price spike for PrNd Mischmetall to approximately 400 US-Dollar/kg in 2011.

The description fails to mention the numerous annotations on the chart that explain the reasons for the price fluctuations (e.g., '2010/11 Lieferkrise', 'Überangebot', 'Nachfragerholung nach COVID-19-Pandemie'). These are critical for understanding the chart's context.
The description omits one of the rare earths shown in the plot, 'Praseodym (Oxid)', which is represented by a light blue line.
